zh.text: 哈佛大学是一所位于美国马萨诸塞州剑桥市的私立研究型大学。该校于1636年由殖民地立法机关批准成立，最初名为新学院，后为纪念捐赠者约翰·哈佛而更名。在19世纪校长查尔斯·威廉·埃利奥特任内，学校发展为现代研究型大学并建立多所专业学院。目前哈佛拥有十所学院及一所高等研究院，主要校区分布在剑桥的哈佛园、波士顿的长木医学区以及奥尔斯顿地区。

en.text: Harvard University is a private research university located in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 1636 by the colonial legislature as New College, it was later renamed after benefactor John Harvard. Under President Charles William Eliot in the 19th century, the institution evolved into a modern research university with multiple professional schools. The university currently comprises ten academic faculties and a faculty attached to the Harvard Radcliffe Institute. Its campuses are situated in Harvard Yard in Cambridge, the Longwood Medical Area in Boston, and the Allston neighborhood.
